# Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (LDOCE)

> > A comprehensive multilingual English dictionary with word definitions, vocabulary learning tools, and topic-based reference content powered by Pearson Languages.

LDOCE is a learner-friendly dictionary that combines traditional word lookups with thematic vocabulary learning, translations across multiple languages (Japanese, Korean, Spanish), and specialized topic definitions. It serves English language learners and educators seeking contemporary usage examples and contextual definitions.

## Key Topics

- Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English
- LDOCE
- English-Japanese translation
- English-Korean translation
- English-Spanish translation
- Word definitions
- Vocabulary learning
- Language education
- Dictionary search
- Politics terminology
- Multilingual support
- Pearson Languages
- Definition examples
- Translation suggestions
- Contemporary English usage

## Dictionary Lookup & Core Access

- [Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com): Main LDOCE homepage with dictionary lookup, vocabulary exercises, and multilingual support
- [native | meaning of native in Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/native): Dictionary entry for word 'native' with definitions and examples

## Multilingual Versions

- [ロングマン現代英英辞典 | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com/jp): Japanese language version of LDOCE for English learners
- [Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com/ko): Korean language version of LDOCE for English learners
- [Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com/es-LA): Spanish Latin American language version of LDOCE

## Translation & Bilingual Search

- [Suggestions for english-spanish | Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-spanish): English-Spanish translation suggestions and search results
- [Suggestions for english-japanese | Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-japanese): English-Japanese translation suggestions and search results
- [Suggestions for english-korean | Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-korean): English-Korean translation suggestions and spell-check results
